title: Feedback Request: How sloppy does this look?
author: BreakSilence_
selftext:
I’ve been building Dreamwell, a cozy dungeon crawler RPG, for over a year. Midway through I started using AI tools for code, art and audio. (See trailer for current footage)

Honest feedback please: does it look good and cohesive, and where does anything feel generic or AI-made?   
Be blunt if you want.

comments.author: daddy_reloaded
comments.body:
Already very good from what I can see. 
More gameplay would be great, cause most of the time the "slope" comes from the gameplay, not the design. I mean, there are tons of successful games with minimal design.

comments.author: samcripp
comments.body: Im not a fan of the way the cell shaded characters look agasint the very soft pastels of the none cell shaded town. either cell shade or not, stick to one or the other.

replies.author: samcripp
replies.body:
Peak of cell shading IMO. You can see the buildings and environment share the cell shading, making everything more cohesive, it belongs together. 

https://i.redd.it/nm3uw9npa72i1.png

replies.author: boredumo
replies.body:
https://i.redd.it/xora2labxc2i1.png

I don't agree. I think it looks great in "order of the sinking star"

replies.author: Yeetli
replies.body: My first thought was to make the character outline transparent so theres some separation from the environment but not as much as there is now. Maybe 50-75%?

comments.author: Exarch92
comments.body: One of the better games ive seen here. Good job! Though i think the decision to give actors such aggressive edge outlines only make them appear as not being part of the world, but placed on top of it if that makes sense.

comments.author: yungastronot
comments.body: Looks good man. Only thing that strikes me as plainly AI, because I'm familiar with it, is the name and tagline of that monster at the end. "The Bottled Sorrow" "What the Laboratory Kept" is very AI-coded.

comments.author: TGG_brian
comments.body: It looks pretty good to my eye. I think the only place where it's less of a matter of opinion (people have strong opinions about cell shading, for example) is the animation. I think that's where the next layer of polish needs to be. But the art looks cohesive and vibey to me. Also love the idea of a cozy dungeon crawler. Would definitely check out a demo if you have one!

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body:
All the buildings and VFX are ai I would say. 
The windows look 2d. Nothing behind the window frame it looks like. 
The fog has clear visible borders. 
It's not a trailer you can't see gameplay, that should always be the first thing you show. 
The birds don't move correct. 
The player slides around. 
To much fog
Outlines are clearly visible through the fog. 

And that was just from watching the first time. 

All in all, from what I have seen, I would say you are about 70% done but haven't seen combat yet. Combat is probably the most crucial part.

comments.author: Material-Watercress1
comments.body: Looks great, art style gives me dragon quest vibes
